description.value: Mr. Sub is a Canadian fast-food sandwich chain with a location on East Broadway in Vancouver's east side. The menu features freshly made subs and sandwiches alongside newer additions like sushi burgers and poke bowls, with meats raised without antibiotics and vegetables cut daily. For a touring cyclist passing through, it offers a quick, customizable meal in a busy commercial corridor.
